mapper.select:
SELECT FROM repair_ticket r LEFT JOIN house h ON h.id = r.house_id LEFT JOIN contract c ON c.id = r.contract_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.customer_id
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT r.id, r.ticket_no, r.house_id, r.contract_id, r.customer_id, r.category, r.urgency, r.title, r.description, r.status, r.contact_phone, r.preferred_visit_time, r.version, r.created_at, r.updated_at, h.title AS house_title, h.address AS house_address, c.contract_no AS contract_no, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS customer_name FROM repair_ticket r LEFT JOIN house h ON h.id = r.house_id LEFT JOIN contract c ON c.id = r.contract_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.customer_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.id = #{id}
